summary: Compact rectangular IR distance sensor module with a black plastic housing. The front face has one emitter window and one detector window side by side. Two mounting tabs sit at opposite corners, each with a round through hole. A small PCB at the rear carries a 3-pin side-entry connector and protrudes slightly past the housing outline.

mountingSurfaces.description: Rear face of the housing and mounting tabs, where the PCB and screws sit. Usable as a flat mounting face using the two tab holes.
Front sensing face with the emitter and detector windows. It must stay unobstructed. The tab surfaces are stepped relative to the window face.

notes: No printed dimensions appear in the images. The overall bounds come from the supplied, unverified metadata (27 x 13.2 x 14.2 mm). The hole diameter and positions are estimated from pixel proportions in the front view, scaled to the 27 mm length, so treat them as approximate. The x axis runs along the length, y along the width, and z along the front-to-back depth. The two holes are on diagonally opposite corner tabs. Tab thickness and the exact z-offset of the tab faces are not determinable from the images. The PCB extends slightly beyond the housing in -y, and the connector sits at the rear.
